full_page.content:
Page 26 Cont. Apr. 14 Henry LeCroix - 31 - drinks is otherwise good provider - Fam. Trou ...
Rose Kusumano - 46 - Nerveous - Fears ... Once a year to confession August Borchman - 47 - very serious cancer of stomach feared.
15 Edwin Scheider - 69 - sick since beginning of February ... Drs. in doubt as to the real trouble.
Dorothy Beckert - in 40 ies - non Cath. - nurse - pertinitis, operation To-day . . .
Geo Ostin - 9 - nose-bleed since 2 A.M.
Page 27
Apr. 16th Mrs. Julia Vial - 64 - Breast cancer - already 3 operations - arm in fearful pain continually - Enrolled Tonight 5.
Baby Sharon Neumann - 8 mo. - convulsions every 3-4 hours. Father a Lutheran .... Enrolled To-day
Mrs. Mary Clague - 63 - lutherin - spells .... a few of them here in waiting .... Enrolled .... $1.
Mrs. Mary Samborski - 51 - in Receiving Hosp. 8 weeks - Victim of shot-gun.
Her Son John - 24 - ostomalitis - has to use crutches
John Karwowsk - 43 - in Univ. Hospital Ann Arbor - Gall-blader - & Sorosis of liver .... Hopeless to Science.
Don Schulte - 9 - intestinal flu and albumen - fever 105-6
Page 28 Apr. 23 Joseph Kuntz - 16 - unconscious since last Friday (17th) Enrolled To-day perpetually - on
Thanks - Richmond - Mrs. Mattin - 47 - lukemia, dropsey ...... given up by all the Drs - Husb came about Thanksgiving and Enrolled her .... again in January. O.K. now - 5039 Burns Ave. - Deo G.
Aloysius Kalizewski - 23 - sent home from army on account of stomach ulcer - now feared as cancer .... Enrolled .50
